changes: Extracted a single shared firing leaf core/experience-hint-surface.ts (surfaceExperienceHints: hintMode+dedup+appendActivityLog+render-gate), refactored handlers/story-review.ts to call it (byte-preserving), and surfaced the rendered+A/B-gated experience hints in handlers/transition-effects.ts buildNextSteps REVIEW branch (after the Agent({lattice-review-*}) lines), gated on story.phase===REVIEW so the eagerly-evaluated REVIEW IIFE only fires the event on the real REVIEW path (F-001). + an 11-check smoke.
usage: When a story enters REVIEW, the reviewer-launch guidance printed by story_advance now ENDS with a "Project experience hints (advisory only)" section (ON arm only) right after the Agent({lattice-review-*}) lines — paste it into each lane reviewer prompt so the ON arm influences review. Every REVIEW round now fires an experience_hint_surfaced event on BOTH arms (hintMode distinguishes; full hintIds = lossless), keyed on the ISO currentReviewRound, so lattice learning_effectiveness ON/OFF accrues from REVIEW (was 0). OFF-arm guidance is byte-identical to before.
expectedOutcome: ON-arm REVIEW guidance shows the hints section + one on-event; OFF-arm guidance unchanged + one off-event (lossless); learning_effectiveness REVIEW-arm N grows per round.
actualTranscript: LIVE on B-5a48 itself (an OFF-arm story): its REVIEW transitions fired real experience_hint_surfaced events hintMode=off hintIds=3 keyed on the ISO currentReviewRound (2026-06-20T12:47/13:01) in .lattice/activity.jsonl, with no rendered section (OFF byte-identical) and NO events from DEV transitions (F-001 fix live). 11-check smoke + ab-shadow-gate 14/14 + full npm test ALL PASS prove the ON-arm rendering + invariants.
outcomeDiff: No diff: actual matches expected (lossless OFF event, ISO-round keying, no spurious non-REVIEW events, byte-identical OFF guidance).
limitations: The CLI HANDS the hints to the agent in the REVIEW guidance, but the agent still pastes them into each hand-written lane-reviewer prompt (the per-item lattice dispatch buildItemPrompt injection was deliberately deferred by operator decision). learning_effectiveness needs >=20 samples/arm to report a non-insufficient-N verdict; REVIEW-arm N now accrues per round.
pitfalls: buildNextSteps returns an object literal whose REVIEW value is an IIFE → JS EAGERLY evaluates it on every buildNextSteps call regardless of target phase; any write side-effect added there MUST be guarded (here: story.phase===REVIEW) or it fires on non-REVIEW transitions (F-001, caught by codex host-2). The hintRoundKey formula (currentReviewRound || plan:phase) must stay byte-identical between story-review.ts and transition-effects.ts so PLAN/REVIEW keys stay disjoint. Hint content must never enter resolveReviewPromptHash (review-run.ts protected) or the A/B arms would differ in the signed prompt.
